look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Inspect the head: outer sterile florets are enlarged and trumpet-like with fringed tips, surrounding shorter central fertile florets. Then turn the head sideways to inspect several rows of non-spiny green phyllaries with dark or pale papery fringed appendages. Check the narrow alternate leaves and slightly woolly stems; blue color alone is not a reliable ID.
taxonomy_notes: POWO accepts Centaurea cyanus L. and treats Cyanus segetum Hill as a synonym, not a separate learner species. The accepted source-pool concept is a species, not a cultivar; cultivated flower colors vary.

project_inclusion.notes: Kew records native Mediterranean distribution and introduction into Texas. Explicitly introduced/non-native; no invasive claim inferred. Keep separate from confirmed native metrics.

morphology_keys.habit: Annual herb, typically upright with slender branches, often woolly when young.
morphology_keys.leaves_attachment: Alternate narrow linear to lanceolate leaves, usually sessile on upper stem; lower leaves can be sparsely toothed or lobed; white woolly hairs may be visible.
morphology_keys.flower_reproductive: Heads at branch ends; enlarged, usually blue but variable-colored outer sterile florets surround smaller fertile florets. The bell-shaped involucre has multiple rows of green phyllaries with scarious fringed tips, often brown to dark.
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Small pale-to-gray cypselae with a short tuft of stiff pappus bristles; needs exact-species macro.
morphology_keys.stem_bud: Slender non-winged stems with woolly hairs; check attachment of upper leaves.

confused_with: Centaurea melitensis — yellow flower heads and stout spine-like involucral bracts; inspect phyllary appendages, not just petal color.
Centaurea stoebe — typically pink-purple deeply divided heads and different fringed phyllaries; check stem leaves and involucre.
Cichorium intybus — blue heads but strap-shaped ligulate florets rather than a Centaurea head with enlarged outer tubular florets.
comparisons.key_distinctions: Inspect the head anatomy and dark/pale fringed, non-spiny phyllary appendages together with narrow gray-green alternate leaves. Color can vary in cultivars.
